notes.title: Update 1.5: Boats, elevators and more
notes.content:
Hi Builders!

Today we're happy to release a new update, v1.5 which introduces boats, elevators and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/cbbde45930faf217d90be5547c9c4c0c4a393556.jpg[/img]

Build a harbour to unlock the new boats and connect your city to the seas!

Another item frequently suggested by the community is the elevator. Place it at the bottom of your building, set up the number of floors and your elevator will take you anywhere you need in the building!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/60ce2e472869cb25c2c0a37305af5e0116e51e11.jpg[/img]

Other new features include:
- New building types: "Gas Station", "Bank", and "Harbour"
- Custom pictures for billboards and other items can now be loaded from your computer instead of using an URL
- Fixed some bugs

Thanks again for your feedback, it will always be essential for us and if you didn't already join our Discord, feel free to come in and share your ideas and suggestions for the game!

notes.title: Update 1.4c: Railways and Trains
notes.content:
Hi Builders!

Today we're happy to release a new update, v1.4c which introduces railways and trains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/66abc7740de731a6ed1e71915b53f1c551ab7582.png[/img]

Use the Road tool and select a type of railways in the tool option, and build a Train Station to unlock Trains.

Please note that the new Train feature is still experimental and there might be some bugs. Let us know what you think!

Here is the full changelog:
- Builing type "Power Plant", "Lumber Yard", "Recycling Center", "Mining Complex", "City Hall", "Scientific Area", "Movie Theatre" are now always available in the new terrain type UI after you unlock them. Press "Other..." to access these options.
- When you use the drone, you can now press E to get dropped from the current drone location
- When you place a road from the drone, your character will then move to the newly placed road. This makes it easier to trace long roads without any drone range issue.
- Fixed some bugs when placing roads


Technicity is currently part of the Steam Builders Fest with a 40% discount, this is the biggest discount since launch, so it's a great opportunity to try our game!

notes.title: Update 1.2c - Controller support and more
notes.content:
Hi Builders!

We continue to implement some features requested by the community, and today we released an update which introduces an experimental support for controllers.

Game menus are still not fully optimized for controllers (D-Pad emulates a mouse), but everything in the game can now be done using a controller:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/2288b6412bfcb1b8eed9f44a923c19fdf4bc80b1.jpg[/img]

This feature is still a work in progress, and we would like to hear your feedback regarding the mapping we chose. This is also a first step towards full Steam Deck support.

Here is the full changelog for 1.2c:
- Controller support (still experimental)
- New custom item functions: 
-- Teleport: Moves the player who activates this item.
-- Delay: Transmit activation/deactivation after a delay (included as a pre-made Part)
-- Pulse: When active, will alternate between OFF and ON (included as a pre-made Part)
-- Updated Seat function so that the camera follows the player properly
- When you create a new terrain from prefab with terrain type "Other" you now can choose prefabs for Recycle Center, Power Plant, City Hall etc.
- Press ALT to force a straight line when you are placing a road
- Fixed a block position bug when placing large custom construction blocks

Thanks again for your feedback, it will always be essential for us and if you didn't already join our Discord, feel free to come in and share your ideas and suggestions for the game!

notes.title: 🚀 Technicity is now available! 🚀
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/65598a9fc86bdd08bf611115ce41fa7d0eb209b3.jpg[/img]

- Improved UI
- Improved co-op mode
- Create a shop and you'll be able to change your player skin using a fitting room
- Share your world to the Steam Workshop and see what other player’s city looks like!
- Various new goals and new types of building
- Interactions with citizens, they can give you a job
- Excavator: Use this new vehicle to quickly demolish large structures
- Build on different biomes of the huge 384 km² map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/7b81f4cf4bc7f09ba63a5c8f496b8115cf33f97c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/c5af2e3865961f5de381eddef49884ca8f485080.jpg[/img]

Now let's all push together to make the release as successful as possible: the bigger the community becomes, the better it will be for the game!

The Co-Op mode is now completed and will be included in the free Technicity: Prologue! Invite your friends to join your world and build new cities or have fun with some role play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/52f92ea301334effd4e3af6bd322ba2eef73bde5.gif[/img]


Steam Workshop is also coming in the free Prologue:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/3e9ab8e20e1cf2b2bd6aef3cf62babd48a847d42.jpg[/img]

You will be able to share your buildings and custom blocks or discover other creations made by the community, including  custom items which can have a useful function and make your world even more interesting.


You can now place several rows of blocks at a time, up to 32 blocks in total:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/cf3ccc7284d8ed1d902d15c33b6af60ae6f32f4e.gif[/img]

Slabs and thin slabs have now two possible positions when you place them, use SHIFT to choose position.
Columns and wood blocks have now two possible angles when you place them, use SHIFT to tilt the block:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/86851ccaefc85b3f2eeef2cd588be6f3ba93babd.jpg[/img]


A new building type will be available in prologue: Taxi Station. It will make it possible to fast travel to any location if you have built a Taxi Station in your world, simply open the Map and choose your destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/4afa8b9f7c1c78e35ada5461940db70bd4eb0007.jpg[/img]

In other news:
- Cement mixer ui was improved
- You can now use new parts types to design custom items: 
  -> Editable Sign (Shows a text which can be edited by the owner), 
  -> SoundBox (Parts which emits a sound), 
  -> Containers (Parts with an inventory)
- A lot of bugs where fixed!

Tell us what you think about this update on our Discord channel. Feel free to share your ideas and suggestions!
[url=https://discord.gg/gTbphhEjNx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

You'll be able to test all of this soon in the free Technicity: Prologue, so remember to wishlist it now to get notified when it's available: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903510/Technicity_Prologue/

notes.title: Demo version - update 0.79
notes.content:
Hi Builders,

First, we would like to thank everybody for trying this early demo version of Technicity and sending us your feedback!

Today we released an update with some changes based on your ideas and suggestions:
[list]
[*] changed controls for placement/destruction of blocks, and item interaction. Now the default is to use Left Click to place a block, E to interact with items, and Tab to open the Inventory. This can be changed from the Settings.
[*] the changes in controls makes it easier to place blocks near items like the cement mixer.
[*] fixed a bug where game would not let you tab out when playing in fullscreen mode
[*] fixed a bug where the car gets stuck as soon as it leaves the road, however you'll need to create a new world for this fix to be enabled
[/list]

As a small bonus, here are some tips for some features you asked about that are actually already in the game:
[list]
[*] A picker tool - an ability to click on a block and be able to build it -> Click on the mousewheel
[*] 1st person view for the drone -> Press F5
[*] Device or a tool for erase a complete building -> The crane can do that, it has 3 modes
[*] Option for infinite money -> Before loading your world, click on "Options" and you can set it to Creative Mode
[*] Nesting products into each other for higher resolution products -> Use the Item Assembler
[/list]


Thanks again for you supports and if you have more ideas and suggestion, join our Discord community:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/gTbphhEjNx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31669490/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Thanks for Playtest!
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

First we would like to thank all of the nearly 1000 players who got involved in this Playtest session! Your feedback is invaluable and will make the full game even better.

If you didn't have the chance to try Technicity yet, don't worry, there is an event coming this monday: the Steam Next Fest will take place February 21-28, 2022 and give you access to a Demo version of Technicity.

It will include a first batch of changes based on the feedback we got during this Playtest session:
- in some conditions people could get stuck in a step of the turorial or have to do it twice, this is now fixed
- changed the starting area so that you can easily align terrains alongside the roads
- made crane and cement mixer area selection a bit more intuitive
- changed the way to order different shapes of blocks
- made the construction vehicles wheels spin correctly
- improved the Road Tool and fixed a few bugs when placing roads
- fixed a crash that some people had, a bug with the crane, and a few other bugs

Thanks again for your great support!
